versions.subject: Merge PR #4888 from @nasbench - Add multiple new rules, updates and fixes
versions.detection:
selection_uri:
    cs-method:
        - 'GET'
        - 'POST'
    cs-uri|contains|all:
        - '/cgi-bin/luci/;stok=/locale'
        - 'form=country'
selection_keyword:
    - 'operation=write'
    - 'country=$('
condition: all of selection_*
